reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text:
This is pretty good, first sunstick i used, and I'm actually pretty satisfied, i usually have a lot of breakouts with something ilke this or just korean products in general (cuz i bought of amazon), but it actually leaves that glow, unlike the other sunstick, but both are really good

like you feel it, you don't feel the sun uv rays as much so you know it works its pretty lit

btw this is my skin then vs now, sunscreen is so important
reviews.zh:
幾好喎，第一次用 sunstick，其實我幾滿意。我一向用呢類產品或者韓國產品（因為我喺亞馬遜買嘅）都好容易爆瘡，但呢款真係做到水光感，唔似其他 sunstick，不過兩款都幾好。

即係你搽完會感覺到，唔會太感受到太陽紫外線，代表有用，幾正。

btw 呢個係我之前同依家嘅皮膚對比，防曬真係好重要。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text:
I love this stick, even though it's not perfect for my skin type!

The stick and its shape make it quite easy to apply the product, though you will need to wiggle it about to ensure you get it into the smaller nooks and crannies. I love the fact that it's fully "hands free" as you can (re)apply it even if you are unable to wash your hands, which makes it perfect for when you're on the go.

The biggest negative point is that it does make my skin look a bit oily; but I believe this is more due to my combination skin type. 

I've yet to try this with makeup, but due to how convenient it is to use, since I received it, I have used it almost EVERY time I've gone outside. Which I've never been able to do with any other sunscreens.
reviews.zh:
我鍾意呢支 stick，雖然佢唔係完全適合我膚質！

支 stick 嘅形狀令塗抹好方便，不過你需要左右郁動吓先確保塗勻啲細微位。我鍾意佢完全「免沖手」，就算你洗唔到手都可以（補）塗，所以出街用一流。

最大缺點係會令皮膚望落有少少油光；但我覺得呢個主要係因為我係混合性肌膚。

我仲未試過配搭化妝品用，但自從收到之後，因為真係好方便，我幾乎每次出街都會用。呢一點我從來都做唔到，用其他防曬都冇試過。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text:
Loved it! 
I recently went to Korea so I got to try a few sun sticks before purchasing them, when I tried this one I liked it because it was so smooth and transparent. 
I live in a city where the sun is really strong so I used it almost daily, in road trips I could feel the protection.

Great product! 
Btw, I have brown skin sooo I can testify that there is no whitecast haha
reviews.zh:
好鍾意！
我最近去咗韓國，所以買之前有機會試幾款 sun stick。試到呢款我就鍾意，因為佢好滑同透明。
我住嘅城市陽光好猛，所以幾乎日日用，自駕遊嗰陣真係感覺到防曬效果。

Great product！
Btw，我係小麥色皮膚，所以可以話俾你聽真係冇泛白嘅問題 haha

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text: If you have oily skin I would not recommend this. I have dry skin and it works very well on my skin. I use this under my makeup as a base and it works well. The sides like to flake off sometimes but it’s super easy to just wipe them off your face. Overall I would highly recommend this sunscreen stick.
reviews.zh: 如果你係油性肌我會唔推薦。我自己係乾性肌，呢款用落好好。我會用佢做妝前底霜，效果唔錯。有時會喺邊位甩出嚟碎屑，但好容易抹走。整體嚟講我會好推薦呢款 sunscreen stick。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text: It gets greasy very quickly. The shape is convenient but I find that unless i scroll the bar up all the way, the plastic will drag onto my skin.
reviews.zh: 好快就變得油笠。形狀係方便，但除非我將支棒完全推出嚟，否則個膠殼會刮住皮膚。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text: I love this sun stick!!! It’s my first time to use a sin stick and I’m glad I started with Abib. It’s super lightweight and non-sticky. It absorbs fast on bare skin. I tried to apply it on top of my make up and it feels amazing. It took a little more time to dry compared to when I applied it on my bare skin but other than that, it’s an amazing product.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支 sun stick！！！第一次用 sin stick，慶幸係由 Abib 開始。質地超輕又唔黏笠。素顏上用吸收得好快。我試過化好妝再補，感覺超好。比起素顏上用需要多少少時間乾透，但除此之外係非常出色嘅產品。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text:
Es una buena opción para protegerte del sol si no te gusta untarte crema y quedar blanca, lo malo es que es algo grasosa y su textura es algo incomoda para climas calurosos donde te hace sudar más. Por lo mismo tarda algo en absorber al menos que te la untes.
El olor es bueno, no es abrimador, no te deja la cara blanca y no estoy segura de que tanta protection solar me de. Pero no irrita y el sol no me quema.
reviews.zh:
如果你唔想塗 cream 又怕變白，呢個係唔錯嘅防曬選擇。壞處係有少少油笠，質地喺炎熱天氣用會有啲唔舒服，搞到更加出汗。所以要塗開先會比較快吸收。
味道唔錯，唔會刺鼻，唔會令塊面白，唔肯定有幾多防曬保護。但係冇刺激感，曬親都唔會灼傷。

reviews.shade: [NEW] Abib Quick Sun Stick Protection Bar 22g
reviews.text:
Ordered 3 sight unseen, relying on positive user experience with comparable Shiseido Clear Sunscreen Stick. Purchase decision made after formulation research as follows:

1. Uses 5 UVA & UVB chemical filters.
2. 1st ingredient is mineral wax (understandably so as this is a clear stick format), with various emollients & thickening agents on top half of ingredient list. 
3. Bottom half of ingredients generally comprises of humectants & antioxidants including green tea, CICA and aloe, to hydrate & soothe skin. 
4. Also has Ceramide NP that supports barrier strength (albeit at bottom of list) followed by ingredients that have pH adjusting & preservative properties. 

Happy w purchase for both personal use and gifting. Glides easily, applies invisible and without residue, leaves skin soft & dewy. Best suited for dry to normal skin types.
reviews.zh:
從未見過實物就落咗三單，係靠住用過類似 Shiseido Clear Sunscreen Stick 嘅用家好評。買之前做過成分研究，結果如下：

1. 用咗 5 種 UVA 同 UVB 化學防曬成分。
2. 第一位成分係礦物蠟（可以理解，因為係透明 stick 形態），再加各種柔潤劑同增稠劑排喺成分表上半部。
3. 成分表下半部大致係保濕劑同抗氧化劑，包括綠茶、CICA 同蘆薈，做到保濕同舒緩皮膚。
4. 仲有 Ceramide NP 幫助強化屏障（雖然排喺尾位），再之後就係調 pH 值同防腐劑成分。

自己用或者送禮都買得好滿意。滑順易推，上妝隱形冇殘留，皮膚留低柔軟同水光感。最適合乾性至中性肌。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
